contact_death.classification_boundary: The filename is only a lead. Central byte pins, load-free save inspection, pristine mounted-media verification, natural replay, and three single-variable controls establish the retained result.

fixture_census.classification_boundary: The filenames are leads only. Every consumed pair is centrally pinned, each state is inspected before load, mounted/save media are pristine, and every conclusion below comes from typed replay outcomes.

overlay_safe_anchor_selector.bounded_role: When player status bit 0x0010 is set, the function selects the nearest X/Z row through pointer 0x80096DA4, writes scaled X/Z to safe-anchor fields, and derives safe Y from ground height.

static_census.bounded_static_conclusion: 0x80054C90 conditionally copies live XYZ to player+0x50/+0x54/+0x58; the pristine LEVEL03/LEVEL.BIN slice at runtime 0x800B3C54 selects and overwrites that tuple for its status-0x0010 path; 0x8005B134 then loads the tuple and writes live XYZ. The scene-10 and scene-4 transition paths use distinct exact pristine LEVEL10 and LEVEL04 writers, respectively. These exact chains are not generalized to every overlay or death class.

bounded_interpretation.observation: The recorded movement causes a bottomless-fall transition; by frame 160 health is 4, lives is 4, and live/anchor XYZ have reset.
bounded_interpretation.inference: player+0x50 is a gated continuously maintained safe anchor, not evidence of a player-activated checkpoint by itself.
bounded_interpretation.causal_confirmation: Removing only frames 57..87 prevents the respawn transition (the broader airborne/fall region still executes). Anchor-X mutation converges even when the three known continuous stores are NOPed, bounding a distinct transition/reset owner for this pit path. At frame 156, changing only the selected scene-local row X by +128 changes frame-157 safe/live X by +4096 through overlay 0x800B3C54 and resident handler 0x8005B134. Clearing only status mask 0x0010 at that boundary denies the row selector while the same resident handler consumes the prior safe anchor. On the Bug Bar contact path, changing only fatal-state safe X by +4096 changes the first completed respawn live/safe X by +4096 through the resident handler without a selector overwrite. Two more pit recordings reproduce the same typed one-frame resident reset boundary in live scenes 10 and 4; their one-word controls distinguish tuple replacement from retained-anchor consumption. Complete bounded write events then identify exact pristine LEVEL10 and LEVEL04 transition functions as their tuple writers without using the operator filenames as semantics or promoting observer timing.
bounded_interpretation.rejected_hypothesis: The stable LEVEL02 pit postcondition is not determined solely by the frame-100 player+0x50 anchor value.
bounded_interpretation.still_unknown: The source and general activation policy of status mask 0x0010, denial behavior in other row-selecting variants, other overlay-writer variants, remaining death classes and stages, lifecycle reset/persistence, and the player-visible activation/denial policy remain open.
